verdict.rationale: CPU architecture support is a fair question for a local inference runtime like LocalAI, so the axis applies. The evidence only says LocalAI runs without a GPU and ships a CPU path first. It never mentions PowerPC or any CPU architecture beyond x86/ARM, and generic CPU support does not show multi-architecture support.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run inference on diverse CPU architectures beyond x86 and ARM, such as PowerPC
